Kasi you can always say naman ninyo, Salen, nagkamali ako, hindi ko na-declare yung income ko. Pero that was, how do you say, legally acquired. Especially if you pay, the final acknowledgement of that is the payment to the BIR. Kung sa akin lang personal, napakalaga na pinakita na po yung mga pera sa bangko, yung cash flow. Atin yung tatanong na yan po sa BIR kung sapat po ang binayaran po nila mga buis. Ayan ba ay tamang transaksyon. You can only find that out. Through the BIR. Kaya napakalaga before putting the cart before the horse is really to end this, how do you say, forensics gathering by the prosecution is the BIR. Then after which, whatever financial analyst they want to present is fine. Pero as far as I'm concerned, so that we don't break the chain of thought. The chain of thought that we've had the last few days. The BIR will tie it all together, Your Honor, Mr. President. So I agree with Senator Sotto. Kung pwede, break na muna tayo ngayon. Baka namang kaya sa biogesic yung kanilang abogado. Dalawang biogesic lang na 500. Ayos na. And he can present the witness this afternoon. But what is important is... Ay talaga ilabas din yung BIR muna bago yung conclusion dito sa financial expert. I presume the financial expert will come up with a conclusion or a picture on how this all, put it all together, how it will all end. So yun lamang po, Mr. President. So I support the motion or the request or appeal of the good Senator Sotto.

The President, Vice President, the members of the Cabinet, and their deputies or assistants shall not, unless otherwise provided in this Constitution, hold any other office or employment during their tenure. They shall strictly avoid conflict of interest in the conduct of their office.

S00785

Meron po kaming revenue issuance na nagsasabi na in case of any transfer or disposition ng kahit anong shares of stock that are not traded in stock exchange, there's a necessity to secure, dapat kumuha ng ECAR from the Bureau of Internal Revenue. At bago rin po itong transfer na ito, Ito ay ma-record sa books ng isang corporation, then kailangan pong bayad lahat po ng mga taxes. So the secretary of the corporation has the duty to check whether or not may na-file na eCAR or to record it. And pag hindi bayad ang taxes, such secretary or kung sino man yung agent dun sa stock transfer books nila, should report the same to the Bureau of Internal Revenue.

No sale, exchange, transfer or similar transaction intended to convey ownership of or title to any share of stock shall be registered in the books of the corporation unless the receipt of payment of the tax herein imposed is filed with and recorded by the stock transfer agent or secretary of the corporation. It shall be the duty of the aforesaid person to inform the Bureau of Internal Revenue. In case of non-payment of tax, any stock transfer agent or secretary of the corporation or the stockbroker who caused the registration of transfer of ownership or title on any share of stock in violation of the aforementioned requirements shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of Title 10, Chapter 1 and Chapter 2 of the Tax Code as amended.
